chapters.title: Ram-Ram Sa: A Greeting the Hand Can Make
chapters.label: ch:mw-ram-ram-sa
chapters.canDo: I can recognise, read, say, copy, and write the respectful Marwadi greeting राम-राम सा, and answer it with the same greeting.

payoff.summary: A two-line authentic greeting exchange followed by independent written recall, using only signs and language taught in the chapter.

chapters.title: Aabhaar: Formal Thanks, Two New Signs
chapters.label: ch:mw-aabhaar
chapters.canDo: I can recognise, hear, say, copy, and independently write आभार as a short formal gratitude response.

payoff.summary: A source-attested formal gratitude word built from two new signs and two signs already taught, followed by independent four-skill retrieval.

chapters.title: Haan Sa: A Respectful Yes, Sign by Sign
chapters.label: ch:mw-haan-saa
chapters.canDo: I can recognise, hear, say, copy, and independently write हां सा as a respectful affirmative answer.

payoff.summary: A source-attested polite affirmative built from two tiny script steps and the already-known respect word सा, followed by independently scored four-skill retrieval.

chapters.title: Paani: Hear Water, Then Write It Sign by Sign
chapters.label: ch:mw-paani
chapters.canDo: I can recognise, hear, say, read, and independently write पाणी as the Marwadi word for water.

payoff.summary: A source-attested everyday noun secured by ear before three new signs are isolated, assembled, and retrieved independently in all four skills.

chapters.title: Mharo Naam: Give One Name
chapters.label: ch:mw-name-answer
chapters.canDo: I can hear, say, read, and independently write म्हारो नाम राम है, then substitute a chosen name in speech.

payoff.summary: A source-attested name statement built by ear before four new signs are isolated and the complete line is retrieved from dictation.

chapters.title: Tharo Naam: Ask One Name
chapters.label: ch:mw-name-question
chapters.canDo: I can ask थारो नाम कांई है and answer with a chosen name in four separately scored skills.

payoff.summary: The question half of the name exchange, built by ear before three new signs are isolated and joined to the already-secure answer.

chapters.title: Kaiso Ho: Ask How Someone Is
chapters.label: ch:mw-wellbeing-question
chapters.canDo: I can recognise, say, read, and write the polite wellbeing question आप कैसो हो?.

payoff.summary: A source-attested formal wellbeing question heard first and then written entirely with signs from earlier chapters.

chapters.title: Thik Hoon: Answer in Two New Signs
chapters.label: ch:mw-wellbeing-answer
chapters.canDo: I can answer हूं ठीक हूं, then complete a polite wellbeing exchange in separately scored listening, speaking, reading, and writing tasks.

payoff.summary: A source-attested wellbeing answer whose only new written shapes are isolated before the complete four-skill exchange.

chapters.title: Pachhe Milsu: See You Later
chapters.label: ch:mw-see-you-later
chapters.canDo: I can hear and say pāchhe milsū, write its four new units, and distinguish it from the common farewell राम राम सा in all four skills.

payoff.summary: A source-attested see-you-later line taught sound-first, written through four isolated units, and scored separately in all four skills.

chapters.title: Four Family Words: Meaning First, One New Sign
chapters.label: ch:mw-family-four
chapters.canDo: I can recognise, say, read, and independently write four source-attested close-family labels after learning only one new Devanagari sign.

payoff.summary: Four close-family labels secured by ear before writing, with only ब added and every skill scored separately.

chapters.title: Grandparents and Family: Two New Signs
chapters.label: ch:mw-family-seven
chapters.canDo: I can add paternal grandfather, paternal grandmother, and family to the earlier four-word map while keeping regional and household variation explicit.

payoff.summary: Three more family labels secured by ear before writing, with only द and व added one sign at a time before the seven-word map.

chapters.title: Maternal Grandparents and Husband: One New Sign
chapters.label: ch:mw-family-ten
chapters.canDo: I can add maternal grandfather, maternal grandmother, and husband to the family map after learning only one new Devanagari sign.

payoff.summary: Three source-attested relationship labels begin by ear, reuse the established script except for त, and finish in four separately scored skills.

chapters.title: Wife and Child: One New Sign
chapters.label: ch:mw-family-twelve
chapters.canDo: I can add wife and child to a twelve-label family map while recognizing that the source records an alternative wife label.

payoff.summary: Wife and child begin by ear, add only च, and join the earlier labels in a non-compensatory four-skill payoff.

chapters.title: Three Useful Places: Two New Signs
chapters.label: ch:mw-places-three
chapters.canDo: I can recognise, say, read, and write market, home, and temple after learning only ज and घ.

payoff.summary: Three source-attested destinations begin by ear, add two signs separately, and finish in four scored skills without pretending the location question is taught.

chapters.title: Hand and Money: No New Signs
chapters.label: ch:mw-travel-five
chapters.canDo: I can add hand and money to the three-place map in listening, speaking, reading, and writing without learning another sign.

payoff.summary: Hand and money arrive by ear, reuse the complete script inventory, and join the three places in a non-compensatory four-skill payoff.

chapters.title: Wind, Cloud, and Rain: No New Signs
chapters.label: ch:mw-weather-three
chapters.canDo: I can recognise, say, read, and write wind, cloud, and rain using only signs already secured in earlier chapters.

payoff.summary: Three source-attested weather nouns begin by ear, reuse the established script inventory, and finish in four separately scored skills without claiming a weather conversation is complete.

chapters.title: Weather, Heat, and Cold: Three New Signs
chapters.label: ch:mw-weather-six
chapters.canDo: I can add weather, heat, and cold to the earlier wind-cloud-rain map after learning only the au mark, ग, and ड.

payoff.summary: Three more source-attested weather words begin by ear, add three signs one at a time, and join the earlier map in four separately scored skills without claiming a complete weather exchange.

chapters.title: Shop, Item, and Price: One New Vowel Mark
chapters.label: ch:mw-shopping-three
chapters.canDo: I can recognise, say, read, and write shop, item, and price after learning only the short-u vowel mark.

payoff.summary: Three source-attested shopping words begin by ear, add one vowel mark, and finish in four separately scored skills without claiming a complete buying exchange.

chapters.title: Cheap and Goods: No New Signs
chapters.label: ch:mw-shopping-five
chapters.canDo: I can add cheap and goods to the shop-item-price map in listening, speaking, reading, and writing without learning another sign.

payoff.summary: Two more source-attested shopping words reuse the secure script inventory and join the earlier three in a non-compensatory four-skill payoff.
